title: quercus pedunculata subsp. pedunculiflora
intro: Quercus pedunculata subsp. pedunculiflora, commonly known as the Pedunculate Oak, is a subspecies of deciduous tree in the white oak group. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Quercus pedunculata subsp. pedunculiflora include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and astringent properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins. The bioactive constituents in Quercus pedunculata subsp. pedunculiflora are believed to contribute to its potential therapeutic uses in treating various conditions, including diabetes, hypertension, and certain types of cancer.
